author: eric29779
body:
Hi my name is eric29779 i got banned 10 months ago for hacking/kill aura. Over those 10 months i learned a valuable lesson that hacking doesn't really give you joy in life. I got really bored and took a big break from Minecraft and 2 days ago is when i started playing and i really miss playing on Avicus the only servers i play on is Mineplex and my friends server. I really hope for you guys to un ban me from Avicus because i really wanna play Nebula with my friends again and i swear that i will not hack ever again because over those 10 months i realized that hacking is just plain boring and doesn't give you a reason to play a game when theres no challenge in it. 

Thank you for reading this :D.
